title: Benchmark Progress Chain
brief: Our CI system records a benchmark score for every build in the order the builds were made. For a performance retrospective we want the longest chain of builds, kept in build order but not necessarily consecutive, where each build in the chain scored higher than the one before it.
Implement longestImprovingChain(nums), where nums holds the scores in build order, and return how many builds the longest such chain contains.
